title: Giving Medication
subtitle: Nursing med pass on the ward

sentences.en: It is time for your medication.
Take this pill with a glass of water.
sentences.target: دا ګولۍ د اوبو له ګیلاس سره وخورئ.

sentences.en: This medicine is for your blood pressure.
sentences.target: دا درمل ستاسو د وینې د فشار لپاره دي.

sentences.en: You may feel a little sleepy afterward.
sentences.target: وروسته به شاید لږ خوب وړي شئ.

sentences.en: I am going to give you an injection now.
Tell me if you feel any side effects.
sentences.target: که کوم جانبي عوارض احساس کړئ، راته ووایاست.

sentences.en: Do not skip a dose, even if you feel better.
sentences.target: هېڅ ډوز مه پرېږدئ، حتی که ښه احساس کوئ.

sentences.en: I will check on you again in one hour.
sentences.target: یو ساعت وروسته به بیا درشم.
